name: Bangla Grammar QA: Question Answering with Prerequisite Knowledge and Multi-Stage Hints
description: A specialized Bangla grammar question-answering dataset containing 10,000 manually curated instances developed for educational NLP, intelligent tutoring systems, hint-based learning, and language model evaluation. Derived from the official National Curriculum and Textbook Board (NCTB) secondary Bangla grammar textbook, each instance provides questions, reference answers, prerequisite grammatical concepts, multi-stage hints, and hint convergence scores.
